bio:
Ugly Sonic is the nickname for the original design of Sonic in the first trailer of the 2020 movie. Fans hated it because he had weird eyes, human teeth, and a creepy look. The backlash was so big that the studio redesigned him to look more like the video game version.

Ugly Sonic later returned as a funny cameo in "Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers" (2022), where he jokes about his failed design and internet fame.
